name: Sullana
queryAndRequestSummary: Separate English and Spanish first-party discovery found the Municipalidad Provincial de Sullana cadastral-plan approval and local zoning/catastro procedure, plus SUNARP's national Base Gráfica Registral viewer and WMS policy. The municipal source was not machine-readable in inspected public pages. SUNARP access requires DNI/date and CAPTCHA; the direct viewer request timed out. No safe anonymous ID-plus-geometry response was verified and no sample was retained.

attemptedRoutes.outcome: HTTP 200 official municipal page; no parcel API in inspected HTML
Official resolution route evidences approval of the district cadastral plan
Official municipal procedure identifies the local urban-development/cadastre/sanitation subgerency; no open parcel service
Official SUNARP resolution describes municipal WMS/Web Map access subject to agreement; no anonymous Sullana endpoint
Browser-like request timed out at approximately 40 seconds; viewer documentation/search results indicate DNI/date/CAPTCHA gating
Official online-services portal identified; Base Gráfica Registral listed, but no anonymous parcel API exposed

scopeLimits: The exact WUP point [-4.90245229069859, -80.6872738207331] was preserved and not shifted; no exact-point hit or miss was generated.
The municipal cadastral-plan approval proves a local cadastral artifact/procedure, not a downloadable polygon dataset or citywide completeness.
The SUNARP viewer's stated national scope does not prove that every Sullana parcel is present, current, or anonymously downloadable.
No raw owner, address, contact, titleholder, personal, tax, account, or other unsafe fields were requested, logged, or retained.
No retained GeoJSON sample was created because no safe bounded native ID-plus-geometry response was obtained.

nativeFieldMapping.compositeKeyProvenance: No parcel response was obtained; no native identity or composite-key interpretation is claimed.

uncertainty: A local first-party cadastral custodian and approved cadastral-plan procedure are evidenced, while public machine-readable parcel access remains unverified. The national SUNARP viewer is identity/CAPTCHA gated and its direct route timed out here. No claim of citywide absence or completeness is made.
